craft_notes: Sthāyin: distinction deferred. Rows: split then promise. Read aloud: held cut.

lines: But deed is mere deed there;
thought-nature is passion, stark by deed-sorts —
so the cut shall be told.
l4.sanskrit_cite: karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate
